items.title: Low snow fractions increase evapotranspiration efficiency across the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem
items.title_en: Low snow fractions increase evapotranspiration efficiency across the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem
items.title_zh: 较低的积雪覆盖率提高了大黄石生态系统范围内的蒸散发效率
items.summary_en: Globally, mountainous headwaters are projected to experience less precipitation falling as snow. Changes in snowmelt rate and timing may affect streamflow generation by shifting the alignment of energy and water inputs which control the proportion of precipitation lost to the atmosphere, or evapotranspiration (ET) efficiency. Since changes in ET efficiency may make streamflow harder to predict in seasonally snow-covered watersheds, in this study, we investigate the impact of precipitation phase on ET efficiency in eight watersheds across the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem. ET efficiency has significantly increased in four watersheds with greater land cover change (p < 0.05). Across all watersheds, mixed effects modeling shows that more available water goes to ET in low snow-fraction years. However, ET responses to snow conditions are locally moderated: groundwater-dominated watersheds are less responsive in the short term but retain a stronger memory of the previous year’s conditions. These findings indicate vegetation water use and ET will more strongly affect streamflow generation in seasonally snow-covered regions during low snow years, potentially exacerbating existing droughts.
items.summary_zh: 据预测，全球山区源头地区以雪形式降下的降水量将减少。融雪速率和时序的变化可能会通过改变能量和水输入的配比来影响径流形成，而这些输入因素决定了降水向大气中损失的比例，即蒸散量（ET）效率。 鉴于蒸散发效率的变化可能导致季节性积雪流域的径流更难预测，本研究针对大黄石生态系统内的八个流域，探讨了降水相态对蒸散发效率的影响。在土地覆盖变化较大的四个流域中，蒸散发效率显著增加（p < 0.05）。 在所有流域中，混合效应建模表明，在积雪比例较低的年份，更多可利用水被用于蒸散发。 然而，蒸散量对积雪状况的响应在局部范围内受到缓冲：以地下水为主的流域在短期内响应较弱，但对前一年状况的“记忆”更为强烈。这些发现表明，在积雪较少的年份，植被用水和蒸散量将对季节性积雪地区的径流形成产生更显著的影响，这可能会加剧现有的干旱。

items.title: Attributing projected evapotranspiration and runoff changes to CO2 effect pathways under increasing atmospheric CO2 across global large river basins
items.title_en: Attributing projected evapotranspiration and runoff changes to CO2 effect pathways under increasing atmospheric CO2 across global large river basins
items.title_zh: 在全球大气二氧化碳浓度上升背景下，全球大型河流流域中预计的蒸散量和径流变化归因于二氧化碳效应路径
items.summary_en: Atmospheric CO2 affects terrestrial hydrology through radiative (RAD), vegetation physiological (BGC), and nonlinear interaction (INT) pathways, yet how these pathways drive future evapotranspiration (ET) and runoff (Q) remains poorly understood. We combine idealized CO2 factorial experiments from six CMIP6 Earth System Models with a Budyko-based water-balance framework to quantify pathway contributions to projected ET and Q changes across 38 major global river basins and identify their associated hydrological controlling factors. Projected ET and Q increase in most basins but exhibit pronounced spatial heterogeneity. RAD dominates ET changes in 30 basins, whereas Q changes are dominated by RAD, BGC, and INT in 23, 8, and 7 basins, respectively. In RAD-dominated basins, hydrological changes are primarily associated with hydroclimatic variables, particularly precipitation, whereas the Budyko parameter n, an integrated parameter representing processes not explicitly resolved by the prescribed hydroclimatic variables, is the leading controlling factor in BGC-dominated basins and some INT-dominated basins. These results show that future basin-scale hydrological responses to rising CO2 depend on both the dominant CO2 effect pathway and its associated hydrological regulation, providing a two-level perspective on future terrestrial water-cycle changes.
items.summary_zh: 大气二氧化碳通过辐射（RAD）、植被生理（BGC）和非线性相互作用（INT）途径影响陆地水文过程，但这些途径如何驱动未来的蒸散发（ET）和径流（Q），目前仍知之甚少。 我们结合了来自六个CMIP6地球系统模型的理想化二氧化碳因子实验，并采用基于布迪科（Budyko）理论的水文平衡框架，量化了这些途径对全球38个主要河流流域预计蒸散量和径流变化的贡献，并识别了相关的水文控制因素。 预测显示，大多数流域的ET和Q均将增加，但表现出显著的空间异质性。在30个流域中，辐射（RAD）是ET变化的主导因素；而在23、8和7个流域中，Q的变化则分别主要由RAD、BGC和INT主导。 在以RAD为主导的流域中，水文变化主要与水文气候变量（尤其是降水）相关；而在以BGC为主导的流域以及部分以INT为主导的流域中，布迪科参数n（作为代表预设水文气候变量未明确解析过程的综合参数）则是主要的控制因素。 这些结果表明，未来流域尺度对二氧化碳浓度上升的水文响应既取决于主要的二氧化碳效应途径，也取决于其相关的水文调节机制，从而为未来陆地水循环的变化提供了双层面的视角。

items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.33179v1 An: cross Abstract: Traffic-related emissions are a major contributor to urban air pollution. However, existing emission models face a fundamental trade-off: macroscopic models are computationally efficient but rely on average speeds, leading to systematic errors, while microscopic models achieve high accuracy but are computationally prohibitive for large scale simulations. To bridge this gap, this study introduces Direct Emission Prediction (DEP), a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)-based deep learning model. DEP was trained on over one million synthetic trips generated by coupling real-world GNSS speed profiles with the microscopic emission model MOBSim. By processing sequential link-level inputs, including vehicle characteristics, road attributes, and ambient temperature, DEP predicts CO$_2$ and % for CO$_2$ and 1.87% for %. Furthermore, validation against empirical remote sensing data confirms that DEP accurately reproduces real-world

items.title: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it
items.title_en: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it
items.title_zh: 地球的下一次冰河时代可能已经开始了。全球变暖阻止了它的到来。
items.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered surprising evidence that Earth’s next ice age may have already begun, only to be stopped by global warming. By studying ancient plants preserved beneath the Barnes Ice Cap in the Canadian Arctic, researchers discovered that the remnants of a massive ice sheet began expanding again about 2,000 years ago, signaling the possible start of a new glacial period. But by the 1960s, rising temperatures had reversed that growth, causing the ice to shrink instead.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现了令人惊讶的证据，表明地球的下一次冰河时代可能已经开始，但随后被全球变暖所阻止。 通过研究加拿大北极地区巴恩斯冰盖下保存的远古植物，研究人员发现，约2000年前，一块巨大冰盖的残余部分开始再次扩张，这预示着新一轮冰期的可能开始。但到了20世纪60年代，气温上升扭转了这一扩张趋势，导致冰盖反而开始萎缩。
